Mr. Mangesh Dhage ESG & Sustainability Professional | CSO Aspirant | ESG & Climate Strategy | Disclosure Controllership | Sustainable Finance Q +91- 9921096271 |

mangesh2dhage@gmail.com |

LinkedIn | Pune/Mumbai, India

EXECUTIVE PROFILE: Senior ESG & Sustainability professional with 15+ years of experience across strategy, reporting, assurance, ratings, climate risk assessment, and sustainable finance. Trusted advisor to C-suite and boards on net-zero pathways, embedding ESG into enterprise strategy, and converting disclosure mandates (BRSR, GRI, CSRD, ISSB/TCFD) into competitive advantage. Uniquely blends financial/accounting fluency with technical sustainability depth — positioning sustainability as a driver of value, resilience, and capital access.

Core Strengths: ESG Strategy & Governance • Net-Zero & Decarbonization • SBTi Targets • Climate modelling, Scenario Analysis • ESG Disclosure Controllership • Sustainable Finance & Green/Social Bonds • ESG Ratings support (CDP, DJSI, EcoVadis, MSCI) • Board & Stakeholder Engagement • Client Management • Team Leadership • Relationship and Network management • Business Development

SIGNATURE IMPACT • Led ESG advisory across 35+ enterprise clients (BFSI, Asset Management, Manufacturing, FMCG, IT), shaping board- level strategy. • Architected SBTi-aligned net-zero roadmaps across Scope 1, 2 & 3. • Directed end-to-end reporting & assurance (GRI, BRSR, TCFD/ISSB) for listed and PE-backed firms. • Improved client ESG ratings, enhancing sustainable capital access and stakeholder trust • Established audit-ready ESG data governance mechanism • Built & mentored ESG teams of 50+ resources.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE PwC India, Pune — Manager, ESG Reporting & Advisory | Feb 2024 – Present • Lead board-facing ESG engagements — materiality assessment, sustainability strategy, GHG Inventorization, Setting SBTi targets, decarbonization roadmaps, tracking financed emissions. • Direct reporting & assurance (GRI, BRSR, TCFD/ISSB, CSRD) and Supplier engagement for Scope 3 emissions accounting for large enterprises. • Advisory on ESG governance, policy, ratings (CDP, DJSI, EcoVadis), climate risk assessment, ESG due diligence, and human rights & supply chain assessment

EY GDS LLP, Pune — Assistant Manager, ESG | Jun 2022 – Feb 2024 • Owned end-to-end ESG reporting & disclosure controllership — metrics, transition planning, materiality, KPI design. • Established data sourcing, review, and controls frameworks ensuring audit-grade, assurance-ready data. • Led training, mentoring, and cross-functional alignment, building organizational ESG capability.

Apex Group Ltd., Pune — Senior Associate, ESG | Nov 2020 – Jun 2022 • Drove ESG ratings, gap analysis, and sustainability strategy for private equity and institutional clients. • Led ESG due diligence for M&A; Climate risks/opportunities assessment; EU-SFDR compliance projects for financial market participants and financial advisors.

SG Analytics Pvt. Ltd., Pune — Senior Analyst → Analyst → Associate Analyst, ESG | Dec 2014 – Nov 2020 • Served global rating agencies & institutional investors with deep-dive ESG research, ratings, and screening. • Led projects on ESG investing, sustainable finance, and financial modelling; delivered due diligence per World Bank safeguard policies.

Earlier Career: UPS Global Services (AR Associate, 2012–14) · EXL Service (Process Executive, 2010–12) — financial and accounting operations foundation underpinning a finance-grounded sustainability approach.

TECHNICAL & FRAMEWORK EXPERTISE: GRI |BRSR | CSRD |ISSB/TCFD | GHG Protocol |SBTi |PCAF |UNSDGs | UNPRI |UNGC | Equator Principles | Green/Social Bonds | SFDR | Enablon |IBM Envizi | Bloomberg | Factiva

THOUGHT LEADERSHIP & IMPACT: • Conducted ESG capacity-building session for MSMEs at Deccan Chamber of Commerce • Participated in an international analyst exchange program (Zurich) • Rural education & environmental initiatives.

EDUCATION: • MBA (Finance) - University of Pune, 2010 • B. Com - Amravati University, 2007

Instructions led learnings and Certifications: • Introduction to Sustainable Finance by United Nations (UNITAR) – August 2019 • Strategy & Sustainability by IESE Business School – Oct 2022 • Climate Change - Carbon Capture & Storage (Univ. of Edinburgh) – Sept 2022 • Climate Change & Human Rights by United Nations – Sept 2022 • Fundamentals of Intelligent Sustainable Business by Noble Work Foundation – Oct 2022 • Envizi Implementation and Technical Fundamentals (IBM) – Nov 2023 • Generative AI Essentials (Microsoft & LinkedIn) - March 2026 • Building High-Performing Teams – University of Penn(Coursera) – Jan 2026 • How Sustainability is changing the Financial sector by Udemy – Jan 2023
